concerns.text: \"**Human reference data** – open HumanEval dataset (C++ entries) downloaded from the verified HuggingFace URL.\" The specification (FR-001) requires human reference solutions from the Codeforces C++ benchmark, not the HumanEval dataset. Using HumanEval (which is primarily a Python dataset and does not guarantee C++ compilable solutions) provides an inappropriate source for the required paired human‑LLM code, jeopardizing the validity of the comparative security analysis.
